title: Hampshire paranormal investigators handed award for 'supernatural research'
excerpt: A team of paranormal investigators has been named Supernatural Research Organisation of the Year.
content:
A team of paranormal investigators has been named Supernatural Research Organisation of the Year.

Paranormal Hunters UK, based in Hampshire and operating nationwide, received the title at this year’s Prestige Awards in recognition of its compassionate and professional approach to supernatural investigations.

Barry, founder and lead investigator at Paranormal Hunters UK, said: "This award is a huge honour for our entire team.

"We’ve always believed that paranormal investigation should be grounded in empathy, professionalism, and genuine support.

"Being recognised for that work means the world to us and to the people we help."

The group aims to help individuals and communities feel safe and supported during unexplained or unsettling experiences.

Dr Iain Lightfoot, co-founder of Paranormal Hunters UK, said: "Our mission has always been to bring calm, clarity, and credible methodology to situations that can feel overwhelming.

"This award reflects the trust our clients place in us and the dedication of our investigators."

The accolade is expected to raise the organisation’s profile in Hampshire and beyond, creating opportunities for new collaborations, heritage partnerships, and corporate wellbeing events.

Paranormal Hunters UK is headquartered in Portsmouth and is known for its ethical approach to paranormal research, offering reassurance and clarity to those who believe they may be experiencing unexplained phenomena.

"We remain committed to our promise: "If you’re Haunted. We will Help!""
